# Emulate (local API emulator)

Honest caveats: prerequisites — Node.js and `npx` (the skill is built around `npx emulate:*`); runs on fixed default ports (4000–4013) that may conflict with your stack; emulated behavior may drift from the real APIs — treat it as a test harness, not a contract.
